product.name: Ener-J HygienePro White Smart Toilet with Integrated Tank, Heated Seat, Warm Water Bidet & Dryer
product.description:
Upgrade your bathroom with the Ener-J HygienePro Smart Toilet, an all-in-one design that combines a modern, tankless look with advanced hygiene and comfort technology. The integrated tank removes the need for a separate cistern, giving you a clean, compact profile (680 x 400 x 475 mm) that suits contemporary bathrooms and en-suites. It works with water pressure from just 0.06 MPa, so it performs reliably in most homes.

The built-in bidet heats water instantly as you use it, so there's no waiting and no stored hot water. You can choose from female, hip, massage, moving spray and baby wash modes. Water, seat and dryer temperatures each have four settings (ambient, 34°C, 37°C or 40°C), and the spray position moves forward and backward for a precise, personalised clean. Afterwards, the warm air dryer offers a hands-free, paper-saving finish.

Hygiene is built into every detail. The nozzle cleans itself automatically, UV sterilisation adds extra protection, and the antibacterial seat and anti-fouling ceramic glaze help keep the bowl cleaner for longer. A foam shield reduces splashing, and the dual filtration system protects the water supply.

Control is effortless. You can use voice commands, the included remote, the one-touch side knob or the foot sensors, which open the lid and seat and flush without contact. The automatic lid opens as you approach, and the soft-close seat and lid shut quietly. The power failure flushing function means the toilet still flushes during a power cut.

For extra relaxation, the toilet includes built-in aromatherapy, music playback and 256-colour ambient mood lighting, plus a soft night light for late-night visits. An energy-saving mode and leakage protection add everyday peace of mind.

product.description: Ideal for Inset Stoves or Stoves with limited clearance, our Remora Stove Fan attaches to your Flue Pipe using the powerful magnetic clamp. It then disperses heat throughout your room ensuring all areas are warm in no time. Available with your choice of Red or Green Thermometer which shows you the ideal temperature to burn your logs. This pack includes a Green Magnetic Thermometer.  The thermometer monitors your stove temperature to optimise performance and protects your stove from overheating. It also clearly displays the temperature of your stove, enabling you to maintain a safe and efficient operating temperature and reduce fuel consumption.  Use the handy Valiant Moisture meter to ensure you get the best burn from your fuel. Our newest model not only has a backlight screen to illuminate the reading but the built-in colour change technology indicates the moisture level of the firewood. It’s an essential tool for any fireplace owner!  Fuel quality is the single most important aspect of making a successful fire. To burn effectively the moisture content of firewood needs to be less than 20%, whether it’s being used in an open fire or a stove. Freshly felled timber can have a moisture content of between 30% and 60%, which when burnt can cause dangerous creosote build-up in chimneys. Using a moisture meter is a great way to check whether your wood will give you a safe and efficient burn, or if it needs further seasoning. The screen will glow green if your fuel contains less than 20% moisture, indicating that it’s ready to go. The new Valiant moisture meter can also be used in timber, floors and buildings in order to detect and measure moisture content.

product.name: Valiant Remora Magnetic Flue Pipe Fan, Moisture Meter and Magnetic Thermometer
product.description: The Remora is a powerful warm air circulating stove fan that features a strong magnetic clamp to attach to your flue pipe as opposed to sitting on your stove top. This means you can use it with any type of stove, regardless of the shape, size, or temperature of the top surface. It also means you can avoid the risk of damaging your stove fan by placing it too close to the fire. The fan is perfect for stoves that have a cool top, such as gas stoves, pellet stoves, or electric stoves. It can also work with stoves that have an irregular surface, such as cast-iron stoves, or a soapstone or angled top, such as Scandinavian stoves. The magnetic clamp allows you to adjust the position and angle of the fan to suit your flue pipe and optimize the airflow. The Magnetic Stove Thermometer in this pack monitors your stove temperature to optimise performance and protects your stove from overheating. It also clearly displays the temperature of your stove, enabling you to maintain a safe and efficient operating temperature and reduce fuel consumption. Place the Thermometer on the top, front, or side of a flat or curved surface. The built-in magnet will maintain its hold on steel up to temperatures of around 800°F (425°C). The optimum position is on the flue collar, or if not practical, as close to the collar as possible for a stable reliable place for monitoring the stove and flue gas temperature. This thermometer is suitable for use with most vitreous enamel, iron or steel flue pipes. For stainless steel flue applications do not attempt to fix to flue pipe, attach to the stove collar or place on the stove top.

product.name: outlet kit for ibc tanks with a s60x6 coarse thread outlet to a 25mm mdpe tee fitting
product.description:
An Intermediate Bulk Container (IBC) tank is a large, reusable container designed for the efficient storage and transport of bulk liquids and granulated substances. Made from high-density polyethylene (HDPE) and supported by a metal cage, these tanks are known for their strength, durability, and stability. Typically available in 1,000-liter (275-gallon) capacity, IBC tanks are widely used in various industries, including agriculture, manufacturing, and food processing, due to their versatile design and ease of handling.

Rephrased Outlet Tap Kit Description:
This outlet tap kit is designed for use with an IBC tank that features a 2" coarse threaded outlet (S60x6). The kit includes a cap that screws onto the tank, providing a secure base for attaching the nickel-plated brass full flow lever valve. To ensure a leak-proof connection, a small amount of PTFE tape is required to seal the thread. The tape also allows you to position the lever tap in an upright position. Once the tap is securely attached, you can then screw in the 25mm MDPE tee fitting, which is compatible with 25mm MDPE water supply pipes. This kit is engineered for ease of use and durability, ensuring long-lasting performance.

product.name: IBC 2" S60X6 Lid with 3/4" BSP Lever Tap and Dual Hose Splitter WL, Complete IBC Fitting Kit
product.description: IBC001S kit includes IBC S60X6 cap with 3/4" BSPF thread, 3/4" BSPM-F lever valve, 3/4" BSPM nipple connector and two-way tap splitter with Click-Lock outlets. The S60X6 end cap is a tough plastic fitting that provides a secure, leak-resistant seal for Intermediate Bulk Containers. The nickel-plated brass lever valve resists corrosion and offers smooth control of liquid flow. The plastic BSPM nipple connector joins two female BSP-threaded fittings with precision threads for a watertight connection. The two-way tap splitter features Click-Lock quick connect outlets and individual shut-off valves for independent flow control, ideal for irrigation, garden hoses or accessory use. PTFE tape may be required for a leak-free seal, sold separately.

product.description: Heavy Duty Vac With Pump. Dual performance, twice the power, the 80L commercial Wet & Dry MAMMOTH240-STXAUTO Vacuum Cleaner has proven to be the best rated dirt cleaning companion, in a huge range of applications, from cleaning up flooded buildings, to building restoration services & graffiti removal.   The 240v MAMMOTH240-STXAUTO is an elite Wet And Dry Vacuum Cleaner with two independently controlled powerful 'twin impeller' motors so you can choose your suction power by having any number of motors on at any given time. To empty, simply unclip the head, and tip back the tank by pulling it up by the front handle located on the bottom of the tank, and tip it back over the swivel bar.   The features on this machine are answers to the requests of the cleaning market for a large industrial 'all-rounder' vacuum cleaner, that is easy to manoeuvre, and able to cope with vacuuming a mixture of wet and dry material, such as drain unblocking, flood & spill restoration. With a power cable of 5m, and vacuum hose of 5m, the V-TUF Industrial MAMMOTH240-STXAUTO offers a cleaning radius of 10 metres.

product.name: Bruder Krampe Tandem-Halfpipe tipping trailer Detailed Vehicle & Playset Model
product.description:
Bring heavy-duty farm transport play to life with the Bruder Krampe Tandem-Halfpipe Tipping Trailer – a highly detailed replica of the robust half-pipe dump trailers used on modern farms and construction sites for transporting bulk materials. Manufactured in authentic 1:16 scale from premium, durable ABS plastic, this substantial trailer is designed for immersive indoor and outdoor play and is suitable for children aged 3 years and over.

Designed with true-to-life Bruder functionality, the Krampe Halfpipe features a fully operational tipping body that allows children to realistically load, haul, and unload materials such as sand, soil, or toy crops. The distinctive half-pipe shaped steel body mirrors the design of the real Krampe trailers, optimised for efficient unloading and durability. When the body tips, the material slides out smoothly, delivering satisfying and realistic dumping action during play. Rugged tandem axles and wide tread tyres provide stability, smooth rolling, and an authentic heavy-duty appearance.

The Krampe Tandem-Halfpipe Tipping Trailer is designed to be towed behind compatible Bruder tractors (sold separately), making it an ideal match for high-horsepower tractors in the Bruder agriculture range. Perfect for recreating large-scale transport tasks around the farm or field, this trailer encourages imaginative role-play, supports fine motor skill development, and adds professional-grade realism to the Bruder 1:16 farming world.

Recommended for ages 3+ years

product.name: ARKO BATHROOM  Universal PP Soft Close Toilet Seat White, Quick Release, Top Fix, Round  Made in Turkey
product.description:
Product Information
Upgrade your bathroom with the Arko Bathroom Universal Soft Close Toilet Seat—built for comfort, hygiene, and long-lasting use. Made from a durable blend of ABS and PP (polypropylene), it offers strength, flexibility, and a clean, modern look.

The soft-close lid shuts gently every time, preventing slams and protecting fingers—ideal for families or quiet night-time use. A quick-release button makes deep cleaning effortless, letting you detach the seat in seconds with no tools required.

Thanks to its adjustable top-fix design (66mm to 166mm), it fits most standard UK round toilets. Installation is simple and tool-free, done entirely from above the toilet pan—no awkward access underneath.

Manufactured in Turkey with high-quality materials and attention to detail, this seat delivers everyday performance with a sleek gloss-white finish that suits both modern and traditional bathrooms.

Care Instructions
Wipe clean with a soft cloth and mild soap. Avoid bleach, abrasive cleaners, or harsh chemicals. Dry hinges thoroughly after cleaning for longer life.

FAQs
Q: Will it fit my toilet?
A: Yes, it suits most UK round pans with hinge holes 66–166mm apart. Please measure before ordering.

Q: Is it easy to install?
A: Very. It installs from the top with all fittings and instructions included.

Q: Can I remove it for cleaning?
A: Absolutely. Press the quick-release button to detach the seat in seconds.

Q: What's the benefit of ABS + PP plastic?
A: ABS provides structure and strength; PP adds flexibility and resilience—perfect for everyday use.

Q: Does the lid close slowly?
A: Yes, the soft-close system ensures a quiet, gentle close every time.

product.description:
Introducing the Suctionloc Toilet Roll Holder in Black – a practical and functional addition to Showerdrape's innovative wall-mounted suction bathroom accessories range. 

For optimal performance, use Suctionloc on smooth, non-porous surfaces such as tiles, glass, or mirrors. The SuctionLoc products can only be successully wall mounted where a perfect vacuum can be created between the product itself and the surface it is mounted on. A lot of newer surfaces prevent this from happening, for example wall panels and showerwalls. This product comes with an Adhesive Mounting Disc included should your your desired surface be unsuitable.

The Suctionloc Collection offers a variety of caddies, baskets, and fixtures, easily applied to smooth surfaces using the innovative Super Suction system. 

Installation is a breeze. Simply position the product, press the Suctionloc button at the centre and let the strong vacuum secure it. The Suctionloc system also indicates when it is time to re-apply the product for maximum holding power, simply re-apply when the red line indicator appears.

product.name: Garland Budget Propagator with Drainage Holes - Small, 23cm Seed Tray for Windowsills
product.description:
Get your seeds off to a strong start with the Garland Small Budget Propagator, a practical and affordable solution for home seed germination. Designed to create a warm and sheltered environment, this compact propagator helps encourage faster germination and healthier early growth for flowers, herbs, vegetables and other young plants.

The sturdy injection-moulded base tray is made from 100% recycled plastic and features two-tier drainage holes that support effective base watering while helping to prevent waterlogging. Maintaining the correct moisture level is essential for successful germination, and the drainage system helps protect delicate seedlings from excess water during their early stages of growth.

A lightweight clear vacuum-formed lid helps retain warmth and humidity around your seeds, creating a consistent environment that encourages quicker germination and stronger development. The transparent cover also allows plenty of natural light to reach your seedlings while making it easy to monitor progress without disturbing the growing conditions.

Manufactured in the UK, this compact propagator is ideal for windowsills, conservatories, greenhouses and other small growing spaces. Measuring 23cm long, 17cm wide and 12.5cm high, it is perfectly sized for raising a variety of seedlings while taking up minimal space.

Whether you are starting a vegetable garden, growing herbs indoors or raising bedding plants for the season ahead, the Garland Small Budget Propagator offers a simple, reliable and environmentally conscious way to achieve better germination results.

product.description: The Balterley Alrewas Floor Standing Combination Unit combines contemporary styling with practical everyday functionality. Finished in Bleached Oak, it features integrated basin and WC furniture in a right-hand configuration to maximise space while keeping essentials neatly organised. product.name: Crikey Mikey Sink & Drain Unblocker, Sink Bomb Fast-Acting, 500g
product.description:
When a plug hole is blocked and the water won't drain, Crikey Mikey Sink Bomb is a fast-acting formula that helps dissolve blockages in kitchen, bathroom and shower plug holes without needing a plumber. It removes the nasty smells blockages cause and kills the germs breeding within them.

It cuts through grease, descales, dissolves hair, and cuts through soap and general organic sink waste — a genuinely versatile unblocker for the everyday causes of a slow or blocked drain, saving the cost and hassle of a call-out.

product.name: Water Butt Diverter Kit Downpipe Waterbutt Filler Kit Fits Both Round & Square Downpipes - Connect Downpipe to Water Butt
product.description:
Rainwater Butt Diverter Set for waterbutts
Diverters are additional fittings that can be attached to your home downpipe to provide a direct connection to your water butt.

Designed to collect some rainwater diverting the rainwater into your waterbutt. The diverter connector kit uses a tube straight into your water butt with the ability to control any overflow when your water butt is full.

Waterbutt Connector Fixing Kit: Allows easy collection of rainwater from your downpipe. Prevents the water butt from over filling when it is full. Connects downpipe to the rain barrel.

Perfect for your garden or allotment allowing water to be easily accessed when needed.

This waterbutt hose kit set includes; 1x rain diverter, 1x hose connector, 1x flexible hose pipe, 1x washer and 1x fixing nut.

Divert rain from your downpipe to your rain barrel fits the majority of downpipes used in the home, including square and round types. Once the water butt is full (if properly fitted) the water butt will not overflow but the water will continue to flow down the downpipe.

FEATURES
Downpipe Rainwater Diversion Kit.
Suitable for both round and square downpipes
Made of sturdy black plastic
Easy to install
Great water saver
Made in the UK

Using a rainwater diverter is a great way to save on costs and time on refilling, reduce your impact on the environment and maintain a supply of free and readily available water for use around the home and garden.

PERFECT FOR FITTING A WATERBUTT TO:
Small garages, Greenhouses / Garden buildings, Sheds & Summerhouses and will fit either 68mm square or 65mm round PVC Downpipe Rainwater Pipes

Moving the lever between 0 degree and 90 degrees controls the flow.

product.name: Invena 3/4 Inch Inline Ball Valve Female Thread For Water With Drain Valve
product.description: A ball valve is a valve with a spherical disc, the part of the valve which controls the flow through it. The sphere has a hole, or port, through the middle so that when the port is in line with both ends of the valve, flow will occur. When the valve is closed, the hole is perpendicular to the ends of the valve, and flow is blocked. The handle or lever will be inline with the port position letting you "see" the valve's position. The ball valve, along with the butterfly valve and plug valve, are part of the family of quarter turn valves.  Ball valves are durable and usually work to achieve perfect shutoff even after years of disuse. They are therefore an excellent choice for shutoff applications (and are often preferred to globe valves and gate valves for this purpose). They do not offer the fine control that may be necessary in throttling applications but are sometimes used for this purpose. product.name: Solar Powered Water Pump Battery Water Fountain for Bird Bath Garden Pond Fish Tank - 5.5W
product.description:
Upgrade your outdoor space with this 5.5W Solar Powered Water Pump Battery Water Fountain, designed for bird baths, garden ponds, fish tanks, and decorative water features. It combines solar power with a built-in 18650 lithium battery, allowing the fountain to spray water even when sunlight is weak. In automatic mode, it runs during the day and charges at the same time. In night mode, it stops operating and only charges the battery, helping extend service life and improve efficiency.

Built with automatic power-off protection, the pump shuts off when lifted out of water for added safety and durability. The upgraded design solves the common problem of older solar fountains that only work under strong sunlight. When fully charged, the battery can support working time for about 7–8 hours, making it ideal for cloudy mornings or low-light conditions.

Made from durable PC material, the fountain delivers a maximum lift of 70cm and a water flow of up to 200L/H, with a spray height of about 45cm. It includes 8 nozzles for different water patterns, 4 support rods for better positioning, and a user manual for easy setup. Compact, efficient, and eco-friendly, it’s a great way to add movement and charm to any water feature.

product.description:

2% reduction SUS 304 stainless steel | PVD

Sloping strips for a linear drain are the best solution if you value a professional approach to finishing your bathroom. Thanks to the shower tray strip, your shower will acquire a neat and elegant look. Aesthetic finish of the track without visible silicones, no need to cut the tiles in a bag to speed up and increase the comfort of the tiler's work.

product.name: VW Crafter (2006-2017) LH Opening RH Fixed Dark Tint Windows Fitting Trim Kit
product.description:
Upgrade your vehicle with our precision engineered Van Windows - built for perfect fitment, lasting quality and everyday reliability. Manufactured to ISO 9001, CE and TUV standards, each window meets strict European safety requirements and is tailored to the exact contours of your van for a clean, factory quality finish. Ideal for camper conversions, trade use or replacing existing panels, these windows combine performance, durability and professional style.

Made from high strength tempered glass, each window is designed for maximum safety and clarity. In the event of impact, the glass shatters into small blunt fragments rather than sharp shards, reducing the risk of injury. The tint is integrated during manufacturing, not applied as a film, allowing around 30 percent light transmission to create privacy and reduce glare. Unlike surface coatings, the built in tint will not fade, bubble or peel, keeping your van looking smart for years to come.

Opening window options feature a smooth sliding mechanism on an internal rail with a secure latch that automatically locks when closed. An integrated drainage channel directs water safely outside, keeping your interior dry and protected in all weather. Fixed window versions offer the same precision fit and premium finish for a seamless, professional appearance.

Every Van Window is delivered in custom packaging with heavy duty protective inserts to ensure it arrives safely. Available individually or as a full set, and with optional fitting kits, they make installation straightforward and reliable. Combining exact fitment, premium materials and safety tested construction, our Van Windows provide the perfect balance of style, security and practicality for any van upgrade.
